newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle bid $112/dressed, passed-trade.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle bid $112/dressed, passed-trade.

text.p: Nebraska feedlot cattle were bid $112.00 per cwt on a dressed basis and passed by owners pricing cattle at $114.00 to $115.00, market sources said.
Packer inquiry was extremely light, they said. Sales last week were mostly at $112.00, with a few loads at $112.50.
There were no reported bids on a live basis Monday morning, with owners pricing cattle at $71.00 to $72.00.
This week's state showlist was estimated near the same number as last week's of 73,300 head, sources said. USDA reported 84,400 head were sold in Nebraska last week.
